title: Add site keeps its Design system card: a quickstart tag with an encoded slash in the query reaches the support and preview doors (tracyWebPath and nativeBackendPath check encoded traversal in the path only)
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout (dependencies installed) run the test files named in run.cmd.
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the tests named below.
expect: tracyWebPath returns /api/design-system/support?quickstart=quickstart%2Fja-kinetic%2Fj6&platform=joomla unchanged off the widget and with /widget/native/backend in front under the native widget.
tracyWebPath still throws TRACY_WEB_PATH_INVALID for encoded traversal in the path, a fragment, or a backslash.
nativeBackendPath lets the same support query through and still refuses encoded traversal in the path and a fragment.
evidence: 19/10/2026 on cowork.tracy.site: readSupport caught Error TRACY_WEB_PATH_INVALID; no /api/design-system/support request; no [data-design-system-card].

tests: an encoded slash in a query value is a value, not a way out of the door
only an explicit native widget mount selects the authenticated Tracy bridge
native backend permits the creation flow and preserves its query without granting administrative methods
